s0301.literal: Fengyuan, Jinning, Xingguo, Yangzhou, Huai'an, Huaiqing, Weihui, Yidu, Panyang, Jinan, Jining, Henan, Hezhong, Baoding, Hejian, and other routes, and Wuwwei, Zongren Guard, and Left Guard Rate Office garrison fields had locusts.
s0301.idiomatic: Fengyuan, Jinning, Xingguo, Yangzhou, Huai'an, Huaiqing, Weihui, Yidu, Panyang, Jinan, Jining, Henan, Hezhong, Baoding, Hejian, and other routes, and Wuwwei, Zongren Guard, and Left Guard Rate Office garrison fields had locusts.

s0302.literal: Pang Zun of Yongping for filial conduct, Wang Jian of Fuzhou for reclusion, Lady Qi wife of Li Wenshi of Datong, Lady Yang wife of Yan Sui of Henan, Lady Chen wife of Pan Jujing of Dadu, and Lady Gao wife of Wang Cheng for moral integrity, Hu Yannu wife of Ma Ben of Shunde, a commoner's wife Lady Zhou of Zhending, and Wei Yihong wife of a commoner of Jining for hanging themselves on their husbands' deaths for joint burial — all had their gates honored.
s0302.idiomatic: Pang Zun of Yongping for filial conduct, Wang Jian of Fuzhou for reclusion, Lady Qi wife of Li Wenshi of Datong, Lady Yang wife of Yan Sui of Henan, Lady Chen wife of Pan Jujing of Dadu, and Lady Gao wife of Wang Cheng for moral integrity, Hu Yannu wife of Ma Ben of Shunde, a commoner's wife Lady Zhou of Zhending, and Wei Yihong wife of a commoner of Jining for hanging themselves on their husbands' deaths for joint burial — all had their gates honored.

s0303.literal: Intercalary seventh month, on the gengchen new moon, Prince Zeze was enfeoffed Prince of Yongning, granted a gold seal, and given a silver-character round tally, relay-station sealed edicts, and the annual tax of his enfeoffed fief was granted to him.
s0303.idiomatic: Intercalary seventh month, on the gengchen new moon, Prince Zeze was enfeoffed Prince of Yongning, granted a gold seal, and given a silver-character round tally, relay-station sealed edicts, and the annual tax of his enfeoffed fief was granted to him.

s0304.literal: On guiwei day Princes Doljin, Quntu, and Boluo and others were dispatched bearing one thousand taels of silver and two hundred bolts of silks to grant to Prince Dolie Temür.
s0304.idiomatic: On guiwei day Princes Doljin, Quntu, and Boluo and others were dispatched bearing 1,000 taels of silver and 200 bolts of silks to grant to Prince Dolie Temür.

s0305.literal: Surveillance censor Ge Mingcheng said: "Central Secretariat Associate Chancellor Zhao Shiyan, over seventy years old, his wisdom and counsel exhausted and decayed, clinging to office with mere tolerance, of no benefit to affairs — please dismiss him to return to his village.
s0305.idiomatic: Surveillance censor Ge Mingcheng said: "Central Secretariat Associate Chancellor Zhao Shiyan, over 70 years old, his wisdom and counsel exhausted and decayed, clinging to office with mere tolerance, of no benefit to affairs — please dismiss him to return to his village.

s0306.literal: " Censorate officials reported; an edict ordered the Central Secretariat to deliberate.
s0306.idiomatic: " Censorate officials reported; an edict ordered the Central Secretariat to deliberate.

s0307.literal: Yi people Awo and Ali of nine villages in Mangbu Route, Yunnan, presented themselves at Sichuan Branch Secretariat saying: "This route was formerly subordinate to Sichuan; now native official Sajabo has joined Yunnan in rebellion; we wish to prepare four hundred shi of grain and one thousand civilian levies to assist the great army in the campaign.
s0307.idiomatic: Yi people Awo and Ali of 9 villages in Mangbu Route, Yunnan, presented themselves at Sichuan Branch Secretariat saying: "This route was formerly subordinate to Sichuan; now native official Sajabo has joined Yunnan in rebellion; we wish to prepare 400 shi of grain and 1,000 civilian levies to assist the great army in the campaign.

s0308.literal: " When the matter was reported, an edict commended their turning from rebellion to loyalty and richly comforted and instructed them.
s0308.idiomatic: " When the matter was reported, an edict commended their turning from rebellion to loyalty and richly comforted and instructed them.

s0309.literal: Guardsmen wintering at Shangdu — grain allotted was at a rate of three parts, two parts given in notes.
s0309.idiomatic: Guardsmen wintering at Shangdu — grain allotted was at a rate of 3 parts, 2 parts given in notes.

s0310.literal: As the grand carriage was about to return, an edict ordered two Shangdu Military Horse Office officials to lead soldiers from Pianling to Ming'an to patrol, to guard against bandits.
s0310.idiomatic: As the grand carriage was about to return, an edict ordered 2 Shangdu Military Horse Office officials to lead soldiers from Pianling to Ming'an to patrol, to guard against bandits.

s0311.literal: One hundred camels and three hundred oxen were purchased at market to supply the accompanying attendant armies.
s0311.idiomatic: 100 camels and 300 oxen were purchased at market to supply the accompanying attendant armies.

s0312.literal: On bingxu day Zhongyi Guard left and right garrison fields — frost killed the grain.
s0312.idiomatic: On bingxu day Zhongyi Guard left and right garrison fields — frost killed the grain.

s0313.literal: Registers of Suochu, Yeliya, and others' treasuries, field estates, slaves and servants, and livestock were taken and given to Great Chengtian Huguo Temple as perpetual endowment.
s0313.idiomatic: Registers of Suochu, Yeliya, and others' treasuries, field estates, slaves and servants, and livestock were taken and given to Great Chengtian Huguo Temple as perpetual endowment.

s0314.literal: A golden Immortal Mandate Seal of Divine Command was cast and granted to Daoist Miao Daoyi, who headed the Complete Truth teaching.
s0314.idiomatic: A golden Immortal Mandate Seal of Divine Command was cast and granted to Daoist Miao Daoyi, who headed the Complete Truth teaching.

s0315.literal: On jichou day the Medical Superintendent Office was established, rank 5a.
s0315.idiomatic: On jichou day the Medical Superintendent Office was established, rank 5a.

s0316.literal: On gengyin day Yeliya's residence that had been registered was made the metropolitan military commission public office.
s0316.idiomatic: On gengyin day Yeliya's residence that had been registered was made the metropolitan military commission public office.

s0317.literal: On xinmao day Shaanxi Branch Censorate Vice Censor-in-Chief Tuoyina was made Central Secretariat Assistant Administrator.
s0317.idiomatic: On xinmao day Shaanxi Branch Censorate Vice Censor-in-Chief Tuoyina was made Central Secretariat Assistant Administrator.

s0318.literal: Yan Temür said: "Zhao Shiyan previously himself said he was old and repeatedly begged to retire; we reported; there was once an edict — Shiyan is an old associate, fit to govern together in the Central Secretariat.
s0318.idiomatic: Yan Temür said: "Zhao Shiyan previously himself said he was old and repeatedly begged to retire; we reported; there was once an edict — Shiyan is an old associate, fit to govern together in the Central Secretariat.

s0319.literal: The censor's words — they did not know there was a prior edict."
s0319.idiomatic: The censor's words — they did not know there was a prior edict."

s0320.literal: The Emperor said: "As the censor says, Shiyan indeed can hardly hold the Central Secretariat; let him still hold Hanlin and Kui Zhang posts."
s0320.idiomatic: The Emperor said: "As the censor says, Shiyan indeed can hardly hold the Central Secretariat; let him still hold Hanlin and Kui Zhang posts."

s0321.literal: Sichuan Branch Secretariat Associate Chancellor Wang Shouchang said: "Yunnan's Bo Hu rebelled; raising troops to attack — mobilizing and supplying provisions all fell to Shouchang.
s0321.idiomatic: Sichuan Branch Secretariat Associate Chancellor Wang Shouchang said: "Yunnan's Bo Hu rebelled; raising troops to attack — mobilizing and supplying provisions all fell to Shouchang.

s0322.literal: Recently for purchasing horses, making weapons, officers' salaries, and soldiers' marching grain — already one hundred fifty thousand ingots of notes have been given.
s0322.idiomatic: Recently for purchasing horses, making weapons, officers' salaries, and soldiers' marching grain — already 150,000 ingots of notes have been given.

s0323.literal: Now Bo Hu is not yet destroyed, yet Wusa and Wumeng successively rebelled; the great army penetrates deep, farther from court; repeatedly requesting military supplies — we early beg issuance and grant; let this province weigh urgency and expediently act, lest there be delay."
s0323.idiomatic: Now Bo Hu is not yet destroyed, yet Wusa and Wumeng successively rebelled; the great army penetrates deep, farther from court; repeatedly requesting military supplies — we early beg issuance and grant; let this province weigh urgency and expediently act, lest there be delay."

s0325.literal: Subordinate counties of Ningxia, Fengyuan, Gongchang, Fengxiang, Datong, and Jinning — frost killed the grain.
s0325.idiomatic: Subordinate counties of Ningxia, Fengyuan, Gongchang, Fengxiang, Datong, and Jinning — frost killed the grain.

s0326.literal: On guisi day Yue'er Temür was made Grand Steward.
s0326.idiomatic: On guisi day Yue'er Temür was made Grand Steward.

s0327.literal: Harachi guardsmen were granted ten thousand ingots of notes and one hundred thousand shi of grain.
s0327.idiomatic: Harachi guardsmen were granted 10,000 ingots of notes and 100,000 shi of grain.

s0328.literal: Chagan Na'er and eastern and western Liangting guardsmen, nine hundred fifty persons — each granted five ingots of notes and two months' grain;
s0328.idiomatic: Chagan Na'er and eastern and western Liangting guardsmen, 950 persons — each granted 5 ingots of notes and 2 months' grain;

s0329.literal: northern desert guardsmen — each three ingots of notes, two bolts of cloth, and two months' grain.
s0329.idiomatic: northern desert guardsmen — each 3 ingots of notes, 2 bolts of cloth, and 2 months' grain.

s0330.literal: Yan Temür was ordered with ten thousand ingots of notes to divide and grant to families of princes and ministers who died in service at the start of Tianli.
s0330.idiomatic: Yan Temür was ordered with 10,000 ingots of notes to divide and grant to families of princes and ministers who died in service at the start of Tianli.

s0331.literal: Mobile Privy Council said: "Two soldiers campaigning in Yunnan fled back and were captured — by law they should die."
s0331.idiomatic: Mobile Privy Council said: "2 soldiers campaigning in Yunnan fled back and were captured — by law they should die."

s0332.literal: An edict: "If fleeing as when facing the battle line, death is fitting.
s0332.idiomatic: An edict: "If fleeing as when facing the battle line, death is fitting.

s0333.literal: If fleeing when not in contact with battle yet always sentenced to death — how can human life be held so cheap?
s0333.idiomatic: If fleeing when not in contact with battle yet always sentenced to death — how can human life be held so cheap?

s0335.literal: On dingyou day the grand carriage departed Shangdu.
s0335.idiomatic: On dingyou day the grand carriage departed Shangdu.

s0336.literal: Alian Temür was granted the Grand Steward seal.
s0336.idiomatic: Alian Temür was granted the Grand Steward seal.

s0337.literal: On wuxu day Gansu Associate Chancellor Naimatai was enfeoffed Prince of Xuanning Commandery and granted a gold seal;
s0337.idiomatic: On wuxu day Gansu Associate Chancellor Naimatai was enfeoffed Prince of Xuanning Commandery and granted a gold seal;

s0338.literal: imperial son-in-law Jinzhi'er was enfeoffed Duke of Yun State and granted a silver seal;
s0338.idiomatic: imperial son-in-law Jinzhi'er was enfeoffed Duke of Yun State and granted a silver seal;

s0339.literal: both were ordered concurrently to administer Mobile Privy Council affairs.
s0339.idiomatic: both were ordered concurrently to administer Mobile Privy Council affairs.

s0340.literal: Posthumously granted Annan King Chen Yiji Ceremonial Peer of Three Ranks and Huguang Branch Secretariat Associate Chancellor, his kingly title as before, posthumous name Zhongyi.
s0340.idiomatic: Posthumously granted Annan King Chen Yiji Ceremonial Peer of Three Ranks and Huguang Branch Secretariat Associate Chancellor, his kingly title as before, posthumous name Zhongyi.

s0341.literal: Yiji during Emperor Shizu came from his state to submit; he was then granted king and dwelt in Hanyang Prefecture; he died in the second year of Tianli — now posthumous gifts and a posthumous name were added.
s0341.idiomatic: Yiji during Emperor Shizu came from his state to submit; he was then granted king and dwelt in Hanyang Prefecture; he died in the 2nd year of Tianli — now posthumous gifts and a posthumous name were added.

s0342.literal: On gengzi day more than thirty thousand persons under Lu Prince Alaqeshili reported famine; they were relieved with ten thousand ingots of notes and twenty thousand shi of grain.
s0342.idiomatic: On gengzi day more than 30,000 persons under Lu Prince Alaqeshili reported famine; they were relieved with 10,000 ingots of notes and 20,000 shi of grain.

s0343.literal: Central Secretariat officials said: "Inner and outer Buddhist temples number three hundred sixty-seven; they use gold, silver, notes, and silks beyond measure; now state expenditures are insufficient — reduction should follow."
s0343.idiomatic: Central Secretariat officials said: "Inner and outer Buddhist temples number 367; they use gold, silver, notes, and silks beyond measure; now state expenditures are insufficient — reduction should follow."

s0344.literal: Secretariat personnel and Xuanzheng Court officials were ordered to reduce expenditures.
s0344.idiomatic: Secretariat personnel and Xuanzheng Court officials were ordered to reduce expenditures.

s0345.literal: Shangdu's annual Buddhist rites at one hundred sixty-five sites were fixed at one hundred four; relevant offices were ordered to make this the perpetual annual precedent.
s0345.idiomatic: Shangdu's annual Buddhist rites at 165 sites were fixed at 104; relevant offices were ordered to make this the perpetual annual precedent.

s0346.literal: On yisi day a Yunnan envoy reported victory; envoys were dispatched to grant Yunnan and Sichuan provincial officials and Mobile Privy Council officials upper libations.
s0346.idiomatic: On yisi day a Yunnan envoy reported victory; envoys were dispatched to grant Yunnan and Sichuan provincial officials and Mobile Privy Council officials upper libations.

s0347.literal: On bingwu day Prince Boyan Temür requested saddles and horses and wished to follow the various armies against Yunnan; the Emperor commended his intent — approved.
s0347.idiomatic: On bingwu day Prince Boyan Temür requested saddles and horses and wished to follow the various armies against Yunnan; the Emperor commended his intent — approved.

s0348.literal: On wushen day Confucius's father Duke of Qi State Shuliang He was further enfeoffed King Qisheng; his mother Lady Yan, Grand Mistress of Lu State, was enfeoffed Consort of King Qisheng; Yan Hui, Duke of Yan State, Duke Fusheng; Zeng Shen, Duke of Zeng State, Duke Zongsheng; Zisi, Duke of Yi State, Duke Shusheng; Mencius, Duke of Zou State, Duke Yasheng; Cheng Hao, Earl of Henan, Duke of Yu State; and Cheng Yi, Earl of Yiyang, Duke of Luo State.
s0348.idiomatic: On wushen day Confucius's father Duke of Qi State Shuliang He was further enfeoffed King Qisheng; his mother Lady Yan, Grand Mistress of Lu State, was enfeoffed Consort of King Qisheng; Yan Hui, Duke of Yan State, Duke Fusheng; Zeng Shen, Duke of Zeng State, Duke Zongsheng; Zisi, Duke of Yi State, Duke Shusheng; Mencius, Duke of Zou State, Duke Yasheng; Cheng Hao, Earl of Henan, Duke of Yu State; and Cheng Yi, Earl of Yiyang, Duke of Luo State.

s0349.literal: Luoluo native official Sajabo, Alou native official Ala, and Lizhou native official Deyi — eight thousand troops — destroyed plank roads; they dispatched steward Cao Tong to secretly ally with Western Tibetan forces, intending to hold the Great River crossing and invade Jianchang.
s0349.idiomatic: Luoluo native official Sajabo, Alou native official Ala, and Lizhou native official Deyi — 8,000 troops — destroyed plank roads; they dispatched steward Cao Tong to secretly ally with Western Tibetan forces, intending to hold the Great River crossing and invade Jianchang.

s0350.literal: Sichuan Branch Secretariat mobilized seven hundred troops of the Diaomen Pacification Commission and one thousand garrison soldiers of Chengdu, Baoning, Shunqing, and Guangan, under Wanhu Zhou Kan, straight to the Luoluo border, to control Western Tibetan forces and various barbarian divisions.
s0350.idiomatic: Sichuan Branch Secretariat mobilized 700 troops of the Diaomen Pacification Commission and 1,000 garrison soldiers of Chengdu, Baoning, Shunqing, and Guangan, under Wanhu Zhou Kan, straight to the Luoluo border, to control Western Tibetan forces and various barbarian divisions.

s0351.literal: Chengdu and Shunqing two wing Wanhu Zan Dingyuan and others were also dispatched with five thousand troops together with Qiongzhou Prefecture prefect Ma Bo's barbarian troops to join Zhou Kan and the rest, by a convenient route to attack jointly; two hundred ninety Chengdu sugar-tax households were dispatched to defend against Xuzhou.
s0351.idiomatic: Chengdu and Shunqing 2 wing Wanhu Zan Dingyuan and others were also dispatched with 5,000 troops together with Qiongzhou Prefecture prefect Ma Bo's barbarian troops to join Zhou Kan and the rest, by a convenient route to attack jointly; 290 Chengdu sugar-tax households were dispatched to defend against Xuzhou.

s0352.literal: Eight hundred escaped soldiers from Chongqing and Kuizhou were recruited and sent to Chengdu.
s0352.idiomatic: 800 escaped soldiers from Chongqing and Kuizhou were recruited and sent to Chengdu.

s0353.literal: Guangxi Yao leader Yu Guo'an led one thousand five hundred men to raid Xiuren, Lipu, and other counties; Guangxi Marshal's Office dispatched troops to capture them; the bandits scattered and fled; Guo'an was captured alive.
s0353.idiomatic: Guangxi Yao leader Yu Guo'an led 1,500 men to raid Xiuren, Lipu, and other counties; Guangxi Marshal's Office dispatched troops to capture them; the bandits scattered and fled; Guo'an was captured alive.

s0354.literal: Subordinate counties of Dadu, Taining, Baoding, and Yidu and capital-region various guards and Grand Agriculture garrison fields — floodwater submerged more than eighty qing of fields.
s0354.idiomatic: Subordinate counties of Dadu, Taining, Baoding, and Yidu and capital-region various guards and Grand Agriculture garrison fields — floodwater submerged more than 80 qing of fields.

s0355.literal: Hangzhou, Changzhou, Qingyuan, Shaoxing, Zhenjiang, and Ningguo routes and subordinate counties of Changde, Anqing, Chizhou, and Jingmen all had floodwater that submerged more than thirteen thousand five hundred eighty qing of fields.
s0355.idiomatic: Hangzhou, Changzhou, Qingyuan, Shaoxing, Zhenjiang, and Ningguo routes and subordinate counties of Changde, Anqing, Chizhou, and Jingmen all had floodwater that submerged more than 13,580 qing of fields.

s0356.literal: Songjiang, Pingjiang, Jiaxing, and Huzhou routes had floodwater that swept away people's houses and submerged more than thirty-six thousand six hundred qing of fields; more than four hundred five thousand five hundred seventy households were starving; an edict ordered Jiang-Zhe Branch Secretariat to use three thousand ingots of grain-for-office notes and to encourage wealthy persons to contribute one hundred thousand shi of grain for relief.
s0356.idiomatic: Songjiang, Pingjiang, Jiaxing, and Huzhou routes had floodwater that swept away people's houses and submerged more than 36,600 qing of fields; more than 405,570 households were starving; an edict ordered Jiang-Zhe Branch Secretariat to use 3,000 ingots of grain-for-office notes and to encourage wealthy persons to contribute 100,000 shi of grain for relief.

s0357.literal: Baoxing, Heng, and Yong areas — fields sprouted green worms that ate the grain.
s0357.idiomatic: Baoxing, Heng, and Yong areas — fields sprouted green worms that ate the grain.

s0358.literal: Yu Shifu of Guanzhou, Zhao Xiang of Dadu, and his younger brother Ying — for filial conduct their gates were honored.
s0358.idiomatic: Yu Shifu of Guanzhou, Zhao Xiang of Dadu, and his younger brother Ying — for filial conduct their gates were honored.

s0359.literal: Aizu Ding and Tasu of Dadu and Liu Zhongwen of Huozhou — for contributing grain to relieve the poor their gates were honored.
s0359.idiomatic: Aizu Ding and Tasu of Dadu and Liu Zhongwen of Huozhou — for contributing grain to relieve the poor their gates were honored.

s0360.literal: Eighth month, on gengxu day, fifteen relay stations including Xin'an and Mianchi in Henan Prefecture Route had famine and epidemic; people were each given one month's grain and horses one month's fodder.
s0360.idiomatic: Eighth month, on gengxu day, 15 relay stations including Xin'an and Mianchi in Henan Prefecture Route had famine and epidemic; people were each given 1 month's grain and horses 1 month's fodder.

s0361.literal: On xinhai day Yueli Temür of Yunnan garrisoned troops at Jianchang, captured Luoluo steward Cao Tong, and beheaded him.
s0361.idiomatic: On xinhai day Yueli Temür of Yunnan garrisoned troops at Jianchang, captured Luoluo steward Cao Tong, and beheaded him.

s0362.literal: On dingsi day Prince Yuejibie of the northern border dispatched an envoy to the capital.
s0362.idiomatic: On dingsi day Prince Yuejibie of the northern border dispatched an envoy to the capital.

s0363.literal: Yan Temür, hunting by the western route, had not yet arrived; an edict said state affairs were of the utmost weight and envoys were dispatched to urge his summons.
s0363.idiomatic: Yan Temür, hunting by the western route, had not yet arrived; an edict said state affairs were of the utmost weight and envoys were dispatched to urge his summons.

s0364.literal: On jiwei day the grand carriage reached the capital; laborers sent out were rewarded and sent back to their camps.
s0364.idiomatic: On jiwei day the grand carriage reached the capital; laborers sent out were rewarded and sent back to their camps.

s0365.literal: Someone reported that Guangling County in Weizhou produced silver; an edict ordered the Central Secretariat and Grand Blessings Court to dispatch persons to oversee the matter; silver obtained each year was to go to Great Chengtian Huguo Temple.
s0365.idiomatic: Someone reported that Guangling County in Weizhou produced silver; an edict ordered the Central Secretariat and Grand Blessings Court to dispatch persons to oversee the matter; silver obtained each year was to go to Great Chengtian Huguo Temple.

s0366.literal: On xinyou day, because Emperor Shizu was born in this month, the capital was ordered to lead one hundred seventy monks in seven days of Buddhist rites.
s0366.idiomatic: On xinyou day, because Emperor Shizu was born in this month, the capital was ordered to lead 170 monks in 7 days of Buddhist rites.

s0367.literal: Censorate officials requested establishing the Yan Prince as crown prince; the Emperor said: "My son is still young — not comparable to when Yuzong was Yan Prince; wait until Yan Temür arrives and deliberate jointly."
s0367.idiomatic: Censorate officials requested establishing the Yan Prince as crown prince; the Emperor said: "My son is still young — not comparable to when Yuzong was Yan Prince; wait until Yan Temür arrives and deliberate jointly."

s0368.literal: On jiazi day Zhongzhou native official Huang Zuxian dispatched his son Zongzhong to court to present local products.
s0368.idiomatic: On jiazi day Zhongzhou native official Huang Zuxian dispatched his son Zongzhong to court to present local products.

s0369.literal: On yichou day envoys were dispatched to Yuhua Palace in Zhending to perform sacrifice at the spirit halls of Ruizong and Empress Xianyi Zhuangsheng.
s0369.idiomatic: On yichou day envoys were dispatched to Yuhua Palace in Zhending to perform sacrifice at the spirit halls of Ruizong and Empress Xianyi Zhuangsheng.

s0370.literal: On wuchen day Venus invaded the Di mansion.
s0370.idiomatic: On wuchen day Venus invaded the Di mansion.

s0371.literal: On renshen day an edict ordered establishment of Mongol script schools.
s0371.idiomatic: On renshen day an edict ordered establishment of Mongol script schools.

s0372.literal: Central Secretariat, Privy Council, and Censorate officials said: "We have compared to the received edict to reduce guards; now the great inner four night-guard guards are fixed so each guard does not exceed four hundred persons;
s0372.idiomatic: Central Secretariat, Privy Council, and Censorate officials said: "We have compared to the received edict to reduce guards; now the great inner four night-guard guards are fixed so each guard does not exceed 400 persons;

s0373.literal: successive-dynasty night-guard guards each do not exceed two hundred persons.
s0373.idiomatic: successive-dynasty night-guard guards each do not exceed 200 persons.

s0374.literal: The eagle factory has fourteen thousand twenty-four persons — four thousand should be reduced.
s0374.idiomatic: The eagle factory has 14,024 persons — 4,000 should be reduced.

s0375.literal: The inner kitchen has nine hundred ninety persons; the four kheshig should each retain one hundred.
s0375.idiomatic: The inner kitchen has 990 persons; the 4 kheshig should each retain 100.

s0376.literal: Successive dynasties' old residence palace-division kitchen staff number three thousand three hundred twenty-four — one thousand one hundred twenty should be retained.
s0376.idiomatic: Successive dynasties' old residence palace-division kitchen staff number 3,324 — 1,120 should be retained.

s0377.literal: Attendant ministers and qer'in households together number ten thousand — six thousand should be retained.
s0377.idiomatic: Attendant ministers and qer'in households together number 10,000 — 6,000 should be retained.

s0378.literal: Those eliminated are to be dismissed to their original registries to perform corvée.
s0378.idiomatic: Those eliminated are to be dismissed to their original registries to perform corvée.

s0379.literal: After the reduction, each guard again had persons who concealed Han, Nan, and Koryo persons and slaves usurping posts — kheshig officials and their chiefs are to receive fifty-seven strokes; violators and those who secretly granted and dismissed are to receive seventy-seven strokes; half of household property is confiscated, and half of what is registered from confiscation is given as reward to informers.
s0379.idiomatic: After the reduction, each guard again had persons who concealed Han, Nan, and Koryo persons and slaves usurping posts — kheshig officials and their chiefs are to receive 57 strokes; violators and those who secretly granted and dismissed are to receive 77 strokes; half of household property is confiscated, and half of what is registered from confiscation is given as reward to informers.

s0380.literal: Surveillance censors are still ordered to investigate.
s0380.idiomatic: Surveillance censors are still ordered to investigate.

s0382.literal: Ninth month, on gengchen day, Jiang-Zhe Branch Secretariat said: "This year summer and autumn had heavy rain and great floods; much civilian farmland was submerged; tax grain did not reach the old quota; next year this province's sea transport can supply only two million shi — the remainder should conveniently be supplemented by transport from other provinces."
s0382.idiomatic: Ninth month, on gengchen day, Jiang-Zhe Branch Secretariat said: "This year summer and autumn had heavy rain and great floods; much civilian farmland was submerged; tax grain did not reach the old quota; next year this province's sea transport can supply only 2,000,000 shi — the remainder should conveniently be supplemented by transport from other provinces."

s0383.literal: Approved; the grain-for-office advancement precedent was abolished.
s0383.idiomatic: Approved; the grain-for-office advancement precedent was abolished.

s0384.literal: Two hundred thirty thousand shi of beans were purchased in Hejian, Baoding, and other routes and Guan, En, and Gaotang and other prefectures; eighty thousand horses were issued for various routes to pasture in division.
s0384.idiomatic: 230,000 shi of beans were purchased in Hejian, Baoding, and other routes and Guan, En, and Gaotang and other prefectures; 80,000 horses were issued for various routes to pasture in division.

s0386.literal: On jiashen day Bulanxi and Yue'er Temür were granted Grand Steward seals.
s0386.idiomatic: On jiashen day Bulanxi and Yue'er Temür were granted Grand Steward seals.

s0387.literal: Shi Weiliang submitted a memorial resigning the Central Secretariat left vice chancellorship — not permitted.
s0387.idiomatic: Shi Weiliang submitted a memorial resigning the Central Secretariat left vice chancellorship — not permitted.

s0388.literal: The Artworks Directorate was ordered to cut blocks and circulate the 《Yan Temür Shijia》.
s0388.idiomatic: The Artworks Directorate was ordered to cut blocks and circulate the 《Yan Temür Shijia》.

s0389.literal: Henan Branch Secretariat was ordered to give Huguang Branch Secretariat four thousand ingots of notes as military supplies for the campaign against Yunnan.
s0389.idiomatic: Henan Branch Secretariat was ordered to give Huguang Branch Secretariat 4,000 ingots of notes as military supplies for the campaign against Yunnan.

s0390.literal: Liaoyang princes Laodi and Manzi and various divisions disturbed the people; the Privy Council, Clan Registrar's Office, and branch secretariat were ordered each year to dispatch officials jointly to tour and inquire, to handle their lawsuits.
s0390.idiomatic: Liaoyang princes Laodi and Manzi and various divisions disturbed the people; the Privy Council, Clan Registrar's Office, and branch secretariat were ordered each year to dispatch officials jointly to tour and inquire, to handle their lawsuits.

s0391.literal: Surveillance censor Ge Mingcheng impeached: "Liaoyang Branch Secretariat Associate Chancellor Qara Temür was once punished by flogging for corruption; now he is again appointed to a chief executive post controlling the eastern frontier — this alone shows how promiscuously state titles and ranks are given; dismissal is fitting."
s0391.idiomatic: Surveillance censor Ge Mingcheng impeached: "Liaoyang Branch Secretariat Associate Chancellor Qara Temür was once punished by flogging for corruption; now he is again appointed to a chief executive post controlling the eastern frontier — this alone shows how promiscuously state titles and ranks are given; dismissal is fitting."

s0393.literal: On bingxu day Qiongzhou native official Ma Bo, who had guided the campaigning army against Yunnan with merit, was made Campaign Pacification Commissioner and ordered to administer his prefecture's affairs.
s0393.idiomatic: On bingxu day Qiongzhou native official Ma Bo, who had guided the campaigning army against Yunnan with merit, was made Campaign Pacification Commissioner and ordered to administer his prefecture's affairs.

s0394.literal: Mongol troops of Jiangxi and Huguang advancing against Yunnan were each given five ingots of notes.
s0394.idiomatic: Mongol troops of Jiangxi and Huguang advancing against Yunnan were each given 5 ingots of notes.

s0395.literal: Luoluo in Yunnan rebelled; it was very close to Chengdu, yet Chengdu's troops and horses had all advanced against Yunnan; an edict ordered Sichuan's neighboring princes to mobilize two thousand men from their frontier divisions to garrison Chengdu.
s0395.idiomatic: Luoluo in Yunnan rebelled; it was very close to Chengdu, yet Chengdu's troops and horses had all advanced against Yunnan; an edict ordered Sichuan's neighboring princes to mobilize 2,000 men from their frontier divisions to garrison Chengdu.

s0396.literal: Guangyuan bandit Fudao Bifu closed and raided Longzhou's Luohui Cave; Longzhou Wanhu Office sent a document questioning Annan, and that state replied: "Our state, since submitting to the Heavenly Court, has diligently performed subject duties; their border and ours are wholly unified.
s0396.idiomatic: Guangyuan bandit Fudao Bifu closed and raided Longzhou's Luohui Cave; Longzhou Wanhu Office sent a document questioning Annan, and that state replied: "Our state, since submitting to the Heavenly Court, has diligently performed subject duties; their border and ours are wholly unified.

s0397.literal: How could Luohui, which was formerly subordinate to our state, give rise to dispute?
s0397.idiomatic: How could Luohui, which was formerly subordinate to our state, give rise to dispute?

s0398.literal: This is surely frontier officials creating trouble, using Bifu as a pretext; your office should itself rigorously investigate and punish."
s0398.idiomatic: This is surely frontier officials creating trouble, using Bifu as a pretext; your office should itself rigorously investigate and punish."

s0399.literal: Huguang Branch Secretariat prepared their words and reported; Longzhou Wanhu Office was ordered strictly to enforce the frontier defense.
s0399.idiomatic: Huguang Branch Secretariat prepared their words and reported; Longzhou Wanhu Office was ordered strictly to enforce the frontier defense.

s0400.literal: On jichou day Mars invaded the Gui mansion.
s0400.idiomatic: On jichou day Mars invaded the Gui mansion.
